findings.quote: We are in network with Delta Dental, Aetna and MetLife
findings.why: The ficha lists only Delta Dental, Cigna and MetLife as accepted insurance, so naming Aetna is a mismatch and Cigna is missing.

findings.quote: Studies show that about 70% of adults who keep to a six-month schedule avoid a major restoration over the following five years.
findings.why: This specific statistic has no citation, and I cannot verify that any such study exists, so it reads as an invented figure.
findings.fix: Remove the statistic or replace it with a claim linked to a verifiable source such as an ADA or NIDCR page.
